entry.title: Sample: Why single-threaded owners ship faster
entry.summary: A sample study of 40 product teams found that teams with one clear owner shipped 30 percent faster than teams run by committees. Critics say one owner can become a bottleneck.

entry.title: Sample: Leaders who ask more questions build stronger teams
entry.content: Managers who ask open questions instead of giving answers had teams that solved problems on their own more often, according to a sample survey of 500 managers.
